banner.body: Crossing state lines = federal crime. Federal land (parks, bases, post offices) = federal crime. April 23, 2026: FDA-approved and state-licensed medical marijuana moved to Schedule III. Recreational and unlicensed cannabis remain Schedule I. Broader rescheduling hearing concluded July 2026; DEA post-hearing brief (Aug 2026) argued for Schedule III. ALJ recommendation pending. Section 781 (signed Nov 12, 2025) removes viable seeds from high-THC cannabis plants from the federal definition of hemp; interstate seed commerce loses hemp-rule protection after the effective date (mid-Nov to mid-Dec 2026, depending on pending extension bills).
